analysis.summary: Checkout database timeouts observed with active connections at 100/100, deployment increased pool size from 20 to 100 connections, host CPU at 96.5% and memory at 92% during the window

hypotheses.claim: Deployment increased connection pool size, causing temporary connection saturation
hypotheses.uncertainty: Connection saturation may be due to increased pool size without sufficient database capacity
hypotheses.next_check: Verify database connection limit and actual database load

evidence_quotes.quote: Database connection timeout after 5000 ms; active connections 100/100
Synthetic deployment changed database pool from 20 to 100 connections

hypotheses.claim: Host CPU and memory usage are high, potentially impacting database performance
hypotheses.uncertainty: High host resources may not directly cause database timeouts
hypotheses.next_check: Check database connection pool limits and actual database connection usage
